description: Biyanwillage Don Rohan Lalith Perera v. National Gem and Jewellery Authority & Another Biyanwillage Don Rohan Lalith Perera v. National Gem and Jewellery Authority & Another View More before Hon. Vijith K. Malalgoda, PC, J (P/CA)
parties: Biyanwillage Don Rohan Lalith Perera v. National Gem and Jewellery Authority & Another Biyanwillage Don Rohan Lalith Perera v. National Gem and Jewellery Authority & Another View More
judgement_by: Hon. Vijith K. Malalgoda, PC, J (P/CA)
keywords: Certiorari – Public-sector employment – Director, Export Services and Marketing – Appointment on probation – Auditor General identifying absence of required basic degree – Termination with contractual notice – Public authority as employer – Distinction between contractual employment decision and exercise of statutory power – Termination derived from contract rather than statute – No public-law/statutory flavour sufficient for writ jurisdiction – Notice refused without costs. P. Padman Surasena J. agreed.
legistation: Constitution – Article 140; no particular statutory provision governing the termination is identified, the Court treating the relationship as contractual.
